<thought>Since the template catalog does not contain entries that explicitly list both “ketones” and “trimethylsilyl” as formed groups, we will search for a more general Peterson‑type template that breaks a C‑C double bond and forms a ketone (the trimethylsilyl fragment can be treated as a leaving group in the forward reaction). This should give us a usable template ID for the retrosynthetic step.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
